questions.qtext: Which of the following is/are not the advantages of PMMC type instrument?

options.text: Use to measure both AC and DC.

questions.solution:
(b, c)
Advantages of PMMC:
• Torque/Weight ratio high
• Self shielding properties
• Uniform scale
• Less power consumption
• More accurate
Disadvantages of PMMC:
• Not suitable for AC
• Cost is higher (more complex construction) than MI and EMMC.
